newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down on continuing retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down on continuing retail selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks slid for a fifth straight session as retail investors attempting to escape further losses in a falling market maintained the selling pressure, brokers said on Wednesday.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) closed 47.33 points or 2.14 percent down at 2,158.22 on turnover of 60.3 million taka. Of 83 issues traded, 67 lost, 13 gained and three ended flat.

"Small investors are a bit panicky as they apprehend further falls during Ramadan," said one broker. Business activities usually fall in Bangladesh during the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan beginning next week.
Singer Bangladesh shed 240 taka to 13,364 and Confidence Cement lost 112 to 1,081.
